en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, 
‘Approximate to this (above Hadeeth), except that he (the narrator) mentioned that he<sup>asws</sup> had bequeathed to Abu Ja’far Mansour, and Abdullah, and Musa<sup>asws</sup>, and Muhammad Bin Ja’far, and a slave of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>.
So Abu Ja’far (the Caliph) said, ‘There isn’t a way to kill them (all)’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd has narrated a similar hadith as the above except that he has said, “He left a will to abu Ja‘far, al-Mansur, ‘Abdallah , Musa, Muhammad ibn Ja‘far and Mawla of abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.).
Abu Ja‘far then said, “There is no way to kill these people.”
